name: Горгон-Топтатель
subject: A very broad horned beast-like humanoid siege boss with blue slate hide/armor, heavy ivory block horns protruding symmetrically upward and forward, two ivory square tusks beside a broad beast snout. Thick squared forearms and block gauntlets, heavy digitless fists; ridged overlapping stone/iron BACK plates descending spine, massive stomping legs, dark waist cloth. Small crimson ember core at breastplate. Large rectangular horns made of a few stepped blocks, not tiny smooth spirals. No bow, sword, axe, cannon, wings or tail. Powerful forward-heavy silhouette and identical paired horns/tusks/back plates in five views.
caption: Пять ракурсов босса в крупной воксельной стилистике; развитие существующего силуэта и палитры.
